description: Check an Open Badge issued by learn.slopped.site, a Slop Curriculum badge or a Slopbox game badge (cart-*): pass the compact JWS (from a baked badge), a credential URL, or a verify link. Checks what the verify page checks (the RS256 signature against the published key, the issuer fields, the dates) and returns who earned what, when, the evidence, and for a game badge how the run was checked. Use when someone shares a badge. Only verifies learn.slopped.site badges.
name: verify_badge
title: Verify a learn.slopped.site badge
